command.switchToTextEditor.title: EPYTOR OFF
command.switchToPreview.title: EPYTOR ON
config.codeBlockMaxHeight.description: Maximum display height of code blocks in pixels. A scrollbar appears when content exceeds this height.
config.editorMaxWidth.description: Maximum width of the editor content area in pixels. Default is 900.
config.serializationMode.clean: Clean mode: minimize unnecessary Markdown escaping and table breaks.
config.serializationMode.compatible: Compatible mode: preserve the existing EPYTOR serialization behavior.
config.tableWrapMode.wrap: wrap: break text at any character (suits long URLs or code).
config.tableWrapMode.nowrap: nowrap: no wrapping; table scrolls horizontally.
config.imageStorage.description: Where to store uploaded/pasted images. 'local' saves to disk; 'server' uploads to a remote URL.
config.imageStorage.server: Upload images to a remote server.
config.imageLocalPath.description: Local folder for saving images (relative or absolute path). Leave empty to auto-detect (images/, imgs/, assets/images/, assets/).
config.imageServerUrl.description: HTTP endpoint URL for image upload when imageStorage is 'server'.
config.imageServerFieldName.description: Form field name for the image file in the multipart upload request. Default: file.
config.imageServerExtraParams.descriptio: Extra parameters to include in the upload request body, as a JSON object string. Example: {"token":"xxx"}
config.imageServerResponsePath.descripti: Dot-notation path to extract the image URL from the upload response JSON. Example: data.url
